Ribbon toolbar buttons now come in two sizes, full and slim. All of them have square corners and a background that stands out slightly from the body. The body has 8px padding, with 8px between buttons.

**Layout** (`src/ribbon/mod.rs`):
- **Body height:** it grows from 76px to 98px, so three slim buttons can stack with 8px gaps inside the padding. That leaves 82px for buttons.
- **Full buttons:** fill that 82px height, with the large icon above the label.
- **Slim buttons:** 22px tall, with a small icon left of the label.
  - Up to three stack in one column, top-aligned; a fourth starts the next column.
  - A full button always stands on its own.
- **Groups:** 8px apart, and each group's title strip runs the height of its buttons.
- **Button background:** laid over the body, so it still stands out on the tinted Code and Spec bodies. It's slightly lighter at rest, lighter still on hover, and darker while pressed. Colours:

  | | Rest | Hover | Pressed |
  |---|---|---|---|
  | Dark mode | white 7% | white 13% | black 14% |
  | Light mode | white 45% | white 70% | black 8% |

**Which buttons are slim:** you didn't say, so I picked the secondary ones:
- **Open Project**, next to New Project.
- **View Divergence Reports**, next to Analyze Divergence.
- **Dark mode switch**, drawn inside a block the size and colour of a slim button.

Everything else is full. No group has more than one slim button yet, so nothing actually stacks today. Each command's size is one setting in its tab's command list, so it's easy to change.

**Collapsed ribbon:** its small buttons now use the slim style.

**Checked:**
- **Pictures:** I drew the Project, Spec and Application tabs open in dark and light mode, and the layout matched.
- **`ribbon_buttons_are_full_or_slim_and_square`:** in both modes, checks:
  - the 8px padding;
  - that full buttons fill the height and slim ones are 22px and top-aligned;
  - the 8px gap;
  - square corners;
  - a see-through background of their own.
- **`slim_buttons_stack_three_to_a_column`:** checks that a fourth slim button starts a new column, a full button stands alone, and all the gaps are 8px.
- **Existing tests:** the ribbon test expected a 12px gap between groups; I changed it to 8px.
- **Everything else:** all 195 tests pass (1 ignored), the release build has no warnings, and `piton check`, `piton build check` and `piton build` pass.

**Spec:**
- **Ribbon scope:** describes the two sizes, stacking, square corners, backgrounds, padding and gaps, and the 98px body.
- **Tab scopes:** each tab's scope now says whether each of its commands is full or slim.
